items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: when I went back and recorded with him later on

ctx.x: I was asking you, and you can answer as you did, about what impact you thought Rudy Van Gelder had on the whole Blue Note scene.

I think it’s just his – wherever he recorded at. I think that he had a style, a way of recording the instruments, that made his albums stand out. I thought the stuff he did on Blue Note, he captured what we were trying to do wonderfully. Later on – when I went back and recorded with him later on, I didn’t get the same thrills that I got in the early – but that’s because the whole technology had changed, and so therefore he gets lost in the mix of trying to add new things to what his original thing was.
